planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: «الإعداد اليوم يعرّف `coverage` بلا `thresholds` واحدة — أي أن التغطية **تُقاس** ولا تُلزِم»
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: The first half is true; the second half is false. Coverage is NOT measured today — `pnpm run test:coverage` fails deterministically and produces no report whatsoever. The run aborts on a timeout before any reporter writes, so the `coverage/` directory does not exist. The premise that a number is already visible and merely non-binding is wrong: there is no number until a timeout is fixed.

Repeated 3 further times: the same single test fails every run (file durations 7524ms, 9155ms, 8285ms). `ls coverage/` → 'No such file or directory'. Cause: tests/unit/architecture-boundaries.test.ts:259-263 builds a real `ESLint` and lints src/pages/compare/layout.ts; under v8 instrumentation it exceeds vitest's default 5000ms, and `grep -n 'testTimeout' vitest.config.ts` → no match.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: The three coverage targets are presented together as deliberately differentiated goals to be reached: «`modules/*` ≥ 85% فروع · `shared/*` ≥ 90% · `ui/*` ≥ 70%»

Two of the three targets are real gaps; the third is already banked. Measured: ui/* 76.3% branches (466/611), i.e. +38 branches above the 70% bar. modules/* 75.9% (1852/2439) is 222 branches short of 85%; shared/* 82.1% (275/335) is 27 branches short of 90%.

Per-bucket rollup: modules 75.9% br, shared 82.1% br, ui 76.3% br. The arithmetic `need('src/ui/',70)` returns 'to reach 70% need +-38 branches' — a negative requirement.
